name: dst_protocol_custom
comment: Custom DST staircase, normalized to its own peak (the -1.0 step), looped until v_min = 3.8 V (a short partial discharge -- lower v_min, e.g. to 2.8, for a full one). "c_rate": 2.0 rescales that peak step to exactly 2C -- change only this number to retarget the whole profile to a different peak C-rate, e.g. 3.0 for a 3C peak (as long as it stays under the cell's max_discharge_a and the EBC's own hardware ceiling, where it is silently clamped -- check the logged current, not just this file). After v_min is reached: rest 300 s (5 min), then CC-CV charge at 2C (capped to the EBC's 5 A charge ceiling) to 4.2 V with 0.1C taper, fully automatic, no charge-phase rest since "rest_after_s" is omitted there. Set "repeat" above 1 to loop the whole discharge/rest/charge sequence.
